item.description: The AsyncOptionBuilder._send() method incorrectly attempts to call .send() on async generators, which don't support this method. This causes "AttributeError: 'async_generator' object has no attribute 'send'" and subsequently "TypeError: 'async_generator' object is not an iterator" errors when processing async generators in test cases.
item.contract: The AsyncOptionBuilder._send() method must properly detect and handle async generators by using __anext__() instead of send(), and should gracefully handle both sync and async generator patterns.
item.acceptance: Tests in tests/test_async_option_builder.py that currently fail with "'async_generator' object is not an iterator" errors should pass, including test_async_option_builder_while, test_async_option_builder_throws, test_async_option_builder_return_some, etc.
